observations: Direct Qwen 8B transfers successfully on time scope, optional versus mandatory actions, actor direction, some precedence and one arithmetic order, and absence of two requested facts.
Four negative/exception questions contain correct cited information followed by false abstention. This is answer incoherence, not missing evidence.
The original exact-phrase mixed-abstention check catches only three of these four. The reversed receipt response paraphrases abstention; source review identifies the same defect.
Arithmetic changes from 12 to 8 between matched orders despite identical facts. One paired observation supports an observed order-associated failure, not a population-level causal estimate.
All citation IDs exist, including the wrong arithmetic answer. Citation membership is not factual support or arithmetic correctness.
Known development role reversal and unjustified why-abstentions remain unresolved; confirmation successes do not erase them.
The optional runtime version observation was unavailable because the installed Client lacks version(). Model digest and request options are verified; server version is not pinned by this archive.
limitations: Eight short fictional cases reserved before selection, not an independently held-out benchmark.
One response per case/order. Counts are trial outcomes, not a general accuracy estimate.
The absent-fact case explicitly says the facts are unprovided, making it easier than arbitrary-document abstention.
Fixed full context: no retrieval, PDF/DOCX ingestion, hostile-document, multi-document or hosted behavior is evaluated here.
No independent semantic model judge used; this is saved source-based assessment.
next_step: Consolidate reproducible code/results/docs and a clearly labelled experimental demo. Retain frozen direct Qwen 8B as candidate and preserve failure corpus. Production reliability remains unproven; do not tune on this confirmation set and still call it held out.
